Package org.oa4mp.server.loader.oauth2.storage.keys

Class KERecord

  • java.lang.Object
    • edu.uiuc.ncsa.security.core.util.IdentifiableImpl
      • edu.uiuc.ncsa.security.storage.monitored.Monitored
        • org.oa4mp.server.loader.oauth2.storage.keys.KERecord
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    edu.uiuc.ncsa.security.core.DateComparable, edu.uiuc.ncsa.security.core.Identifiable, Serializable, Cloneable
    public class KERecord
extends edu.uiuc.ncsa.security.storage.monitored.Monitored
    Store entry that models a single JWK key. It contains all the administrative information for the key, as well as the actual key itself.

    Each key has a VI (no VI means default). Much of this is usually also in the key itself, but pulling it out allows for searching and better management.

      • fromJWK

        public void fromJWK​(edu.uiuc.ncsa.security.util.jwk.JSONWebKey jwk,
                    boolean isDefault)
             throws NoSuchAlgorithmException,
                    InvalidKeySpecException
        Imports the JSONWebKey into this record. At the end, the recrod represents the web key. See also toJWK().

        Note

        The key is not set valid automatically, since that is not part of the actual key, nor is there a description or virtual issuer set.
        Parameters:
        jwk -
        isDefault -
        Throws:
        NoSuchAlgorithmException
        InvalidKeySpecException
